rationale: Both are warm, editorial and well typeset, but Y has a richer hero with a framed photo plus contact-sheet thumbnails, more varied section treatments (dark metrics band, vermilion CTA, journal sidebar) and distinctive line-art feature icons. X is clean and elegant, with a strong tile-and-window hero illustration, but its layout follows a more predictable stacked-section pattern and its mobile hero pushes the visual below the fold. Y is the one a design director would ship; X is the more template-like.
